nodes.label: _copy_source_messages
nodes.rationale: Implements strict lookback fetch with checkpoint gating and duplicate removal via recent ID window. Includes cursor self-heal if state is ahead of live fetch.

nodes.label: _save_state
nodes.rationale: Handles oversized state payloads by compacting them before save to prevent MessageTooLongError in Telegram Saved Messages fallback.

nodes.label: _repost_messages_without_forward
nodes.rationale: Provides a fallback path for protected/forward-restricted chats by directly sending content without forward attribution.

nodes.label: AI Integration Guide
nodes.rationale: Proposes a shadow mode for AI evaluation where decisions are logged but do not affect output until validated.

nodes.label: _sanitize_message_text
nodes.rationale: Removes Telegram and YouTube links and specific bad words to clean content before forwarding.

nodes.label: _should_skip_message_text
nodes.rationale: Blocks messages containing ad markers or generic ad words if enabled.
